note: Upcoming crossplay changes for /coming-soon/. The Crossplay watch routine removes an item once it has shipped (and logs it on the game page).

items.title: No Rest for the Wicked
items.what: Version 1.0 leaves Early Access on PC and PS5 together, with full crossplay and cross-save between them. Xbox Series X|S and Switch 2 versions come later.

items.title: Tom Clancy's The Division 2
items.what: Crossplay rolls out: PC moves to the new servers around November 10, with Xbox and PlayStation following in mid-November.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI
items.what: Launches on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar hasn't said whether it has crossplay.

items.title: Golf With Your Friends
items.what: Golf With Your Friends 2 launches on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2 and PC with full cross-platform play for up to 12 players.

items.title: Forza Horizon 6
items.what: The PS5 version launches (early access January 21 with the Premium Edition) and joins Xbox and PC crossplay and cross-save.

items.title: Risk of Rain 2
items.what: 2K says the next PlayStation and Xbox update ends PS4–PS5 and Xbox One–Series X|S play.

items.title: Terraria
items.what: Crossplay Phase One (update 1.4.6) is coming "in the near future", per Re-Logic.

items.title: Peak
items.what: Console versions are in the works, and Landfall says console players will play with the Steam community.

items.title: The Elder Scrolls Online
items.what: ZeniMax says full crossplay and cross-progression are in development, but not coming in 2026.

items.title: Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero
items.what: Bandai Namco plans a crossplay beta for PS5, Xbox Series X|S and Steam.
